
```{r setup_explainer}
# TODO: remove
# t0 <- 30
# horizon <- 100

npi <- daedalus_timed_npi(
  t0, horizon, list(rep(0.9, 45)), country
)
elim <- daedalus_timed_npi(
  t0, horizon, list(rep(0.7, 45)), country
)

# gives an epi curve that fits illustrative purposes well
# tweak this to get a curve that suits the t0 and horizon chosen
# the infection is purely illustrative; need not match the workshop infection
explainer_infection <- daedalus_infection("sars_cov_1", r0 = 3)

default <- daedalus(country, explainer_infection, time_end = horizon)
mitigated <- daedalus(country, explainer_infection, npi, time_end = horizon)
eliminated <- daedalus(country, explainer_infection, elim, time_end = horizon)

ts_default <- get_incidence(default, "infections")
ts_mitigated <- get_incidence(mitigated, "infections")
ts_eliminated <- get_incidence(eliminated, "infections")

ts_default$scenario <- "default"
ts_mitigated$scenario <- "mitigated"
ts_eliminated$scenario <- "eliminated"

df_explainer <- bind_rows(ts_default, ts_mitigated, ts_eliminated)
```

```{r explainer_p_01}
plot_explainer_1 <- ggplot(df_explainer) +
  geom_line(
    aes(time, value, linetype = scenario),
  ) +
  geom_vline(,
    xintercept = c(t0, horizon),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = c("red", "grey")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(t0, seq(0, horizon, by = horizon / 4)),
    labels = function(x) {
        def_labs <- glue::glue("Day {round(x)}")
        def_labs[x == 0] <- glue::glue(
            "Day 0
            
            First detected
            case in {country}"
        )
        def_labs[x == horizon] <- glue::glue(
            "Day {horizon}

            End of projection horizon"
        )
        def_labs[x == t0] <- glue::glue(
            "
            

            Day {t0}: Start of exercise"
        )

        def_labs
    },
    limits = c(0, horizon * 1.2)
  ) +
  scale_linetype_discrete(
    labels = c("No closures", "Severe mitigation", "Loose mitigation")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Timeline",
    y = "Number of detected cases",
    linetype = NULL
  ) +
  theme_explainer()

ggsave(
  file.path(figs_out, "plot_explainer_01.png"),
  plot_explainer_1, height = 7, width = 10
)
```

```{r explainer_p_02}
# get 10 samples of daily incidence under a plausible mitigation strategy
explainer_infection <- withr::with_seed(
    1,
    {
        make_infection_samples(
            "sars_cov_1",
            samples = 10,
            list(
                r0 = distributional::dist_beta(2, 5),
                sigma = distributional::dist_beta(2, 5)
            ),
            list(r0 = c(2.5, 3.0), sigma = c(0.2, 0.4))
        )
    }
)

outputs <- run_scenarios(
    country, explainer_infection, response_strategy = npi, time_end = horizon
)
tags <- glue::glue(
    "infection_{seq_along(explainer_infection)}"
)
df_uncertainty <- get_epicurve_data(outputs, tags)
df_uncertainty <- filter(df_uncertainty, measure == "daily_infections")

# plot uncertainty as curves
plot_explainer_2 <- ggplot(df_uncertainty) +
  geom_line(
    aes(time, value, group = tag),
    colour = "grey40", linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_vline(,
    xintercept = c(t0, horizon),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = c("red", "grey")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(t0, seq(0, horizon, by = horizon / 4)),
    labels = function(x) {
        def_labs <- glue::glue("Day {round(x)}")
        def_labs[x == 0] <- glue::glue(
            "Day 0
            
            First detected
            case in {country}"
        )
        def_labs[x == horizon] <- glue::glue(
            "Day {horizon}

            End of projection horizon"
        )
        def_labs[x == t0] <- glue::glue(
            "
            

            Day {t0}: Start of exercise"
        )

        def_labs
    },
    limits = c(0, horizon * 1.2)
  ) +
  scale_linetype_discrete(
    labels = c("No closures", "Severe mitigation", "Loose mitigation")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Timeline",
    y = "Number of detected cases",
    linetype = NULL
  ) +
  theme_explainer()

ggsave(
  file.path(figs_out, "plot_explainer_02.png"),
  plot_explainer_2, height = 7, width = 10
)
```

```{r explainer_p_03}
# get 10 samples of daily incidence under a plausible mitigation strategy
explainer_infection <- withr::with_seed(
    1,
    {
        make_infection_samples(
            "sars_cov_1",
            samples = 10,
            list(
                r0 = distributional::dist_beta(2, 5),
                sigma = distributional::dist_beta(2, 4)
            ),
            list(r0 = c(2.6, 2.65), sigma = c(0.2, 0.4))
        )
    }
)

horizon_new <- final_horizon

npi <- daedalus_timed_npi(
  t0, horizon_new, list(rep(0.9, 45)), country
)

outputs <- run_scenarios(
    country, explainer_infection,
    response_strategy = npi, time_end = horizon_new
)
tags <- glue::glue(
    "infection_{seq_along(explainer_infection)}"
)
df_uncertainty <- get_epicurve_data(outputs, tags)
df_uncertainty <- filter(df_uncertainty, measure == "daily_infections")

# plot uncertainty as curves
plot_explainer_3 <- ggplot(df_uncertainty) +
  stat_summary(
        aes(time, value),
        geom = "ribbon", fill = "grey80"
    ) +
  stat_summary(
        aes(time, value),
        geom = "line"
    ) +
  geom_vline(,
    xintercept = c(t0, horizon),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = c("red", "grey")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, t0, horizon, horizon_new),
    labels = function(x) glue::glue("Day {round(x)}"),
    limits = c(0, horizon_new * 1.1)
  ) +
  scale_linetype_discrete(
    labels = c("No closures", "Severe mitigation", "Loose mitigation")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Timeline",
    y = "Number of detected cases",
    linetype = NULL
  ) +
  theme_explainer()

ggsave(
  file.path(figs_out, "plot_explainer_03.png"),
  plot_explainer_3, height = 7, width = 10
)
```
